6845814.reason: Iterates days 1 through 3000 only, omitting the last legal harvest day 3001 for fruit ripening on day 3000. Valid test 0008 (one tree, v=10, day 3000, 30 fruit) returns 10 instead of 20.

6850840.reason: Appends every tree day to an already constructed set of harvest days, then processes duplicate days again with a fresh daily limit, including out-of-order dates and expired leftovers. Valid test 0002 returns 90 although five 20-fruit trees on days 1..5 with v=10 permit only 60.

6852929.reason: Ignores each tree ripening day and indexes fruit by input-row number; its transition also adds unclamped negative leftover amounts. Valid test 0003 returns -11606 instead of 10596.

6855572.reason: Resets b_last before handling current fruit, but fails to retain that fruit when old leftovers exhaust daily capacity. The no-new-fruit branch also leaves stale carry unexpired. Valid test 0006 undercounts 15943 instead of 18465; the missing-carry defect alone gives 6 instead of 9 for v=3 and trees (1,6),(2,3).

6857892.reason: Loops only through day 3000, omitting day 3001. On valid test 0008 (one tree ripening on day 3000, 30 fruit, v=10), returns 10 instead of 20.
